ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is an air quality daily report table of “Beijing Municipality Pollution Indexes of Various Pollutants”; the monitoring dates include February 16, March 2, March 16, April 2, April 15, May 2, etc.; the pollutant items include sulfur dioxide, carbon monoxide, ozone, nitrogen dioxide, and inhalable particulate matter. In the table, the inhalable particulate matter index reaches 500 on March 16, is 260 on April 2, and is 324 on April 15; the values in the spring period are obviously relatively high. Then reason: the relatively high inhalable particulate matter indicates that during this period Beijing is mainly affected by raised dust and particulate matter pollution. The question requires answering the reason from the perspective of weather activity. In Beijing spring, cold air often moves southward, cold front activity is frequent, and the passage of cold fronts easily brings strong winds and raised dust, thereby aggravating inhalable particulate matter pollution. Therefore another most important reason is that cold front activity is frequent.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：北京空气质量日报的表格给出2月16日到5月2日多次监测数据，其中“可吸入颗粒物”一列在春季时段明显偏高，说明这一时期北京首要污染物与春季扬尘/颗粒物污染有关。再看文字：题目要求从“天气活动角度”回答“另一个最重要原因”。结合地理知识，春季北京常受冷空气南下影响，冷锋过境频繁，会带来大风、扬尘并加重颗粒物污染，所以答案选“冷锋活动频繁”。
